notes: API overview: "New API key issuance is currently paused and cannot be requested." So this preset is only for people who already have a key, and is off by default.
API guidelines: "Always credit our photographers when possible (e.g. 'Photo by John Doe on Pexels' with a link to the photo page on Pexels)." So the credit uses that wording.
License: commercial use and changes are allowed and attribution is not required; the prohibited uses are listed under use.prohibited.
The documentation says nothing about hotlinking or caching. Images are downloaded, and searches are cached for an hour.
Rate limit: 200 requests per hour and 20,000 per month.
No endpoint is documented to call when a photo is used, so there is no on-pick URL.

prohibited: Pexels: don't sell unaltered copies of the photo, e.g. as a poster, print or on a physical product.
Pexels: don't show identifiable people in a bad light or in an offensive way.
Pexels: don't imply that people or brands in the photo endorse your product.
Pexels: don't use the photo as part of a trademark, design mark, trade name, business name or service mark.
Pexels: don't use the photo in a political context, such as promoting a party or candidate.
